Ordinance

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

Section 1, Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by the changing all of the B3-2 Community Shopping
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 15-I in the area bound by:

West Peterson Avenue; a public alley next east of and parallel to North Artesian
Avenue; a public alley next south of and parallel to West Peterson Avenue; and North

Artesian Avenue

to those of C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial District.

Section 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 2415-25 West Peterson Avenue, Chicago, Illinois.
